lane: S007 native gravity Qwen3.8 argmax collapse
root_cause: The packer applied mlx_residual_norm_to_delta (weight-1) to a HuggingFace Gemma-RMSNorm dump that already stores delta-from-one. Q80 residual/q_norm/k_norm kernels apply (1+w), so the residual stream was multiplied by ~w_hf instead of ~(1+w_hf). Layer-0 input RMSNorm L2 collapsed from 69.73 to 3.57 (ratio 0.051). Decode then argmax-collapsed to token 150910 (byte-level BPE '´ī') which the tokenizer rendered as U+FFFD.
not_the_cause: tied embeddings: config.tie_word_embeddings=false and text_config.tie_word_embeddings=false; index contains independent lm_head.weight
mixer-kind: qwen38_mixer_kind (layer+1)%4==0 matches config.layer_types and the tensors on disk (48 linear_attn + 16 self_attn, zero mismatches)
Q4 kernels / quantization: pack min_q4_cosine was 0.98948 on the collapsing artifact; oracle embed row cosine 0.99348; decode speed matched the 33.1 tok/s historical anchor

step1_tied_embeddings.packer_remap: canonicalize_qwen38_source_name maps lm_head.weight -> language_model.lm_head.weight and model.language_model.* -> language_model.model.*; missing lm_head would error at pack_q4_from_source('language_model.lm_head.weight'), not silently zero

step3_numpy_oracle.transformers_authority: Qwen3_5RMSNorm = Qwen3NextRMSNorm = Gemma3RMSNorm; y = rms(x)*(1+weight), zeros-init. Qwen3_5PreTrainedModel._init_weights: 'We initialize with 0s to be 1 centered as the RMSNorm here does (1 + weight)'.

fix.change: Detect HuggingFace dumps (lm_head.weight or model.language_model.* keys). For those, store residual/q_norm/k_norm/final-norm f32 as the source delta and skip reuse of previously converted (weight-1) f32 files. MLX catalogs still subtract 1. linear_attn.norm is unchanged (ones-init, kernel multiplies by weight).
fix.repack: Q4 reused in place (3s). 161 Gemma-delta f32 tensors rewritten. Artifact 13.316 GiB, 402 q4 + 353 f32.
